agent-workspace-trust-copy.title: Trust the folder when Orca starts an agent
agent-workspace-trust-copy.description: Agents Orca starts skip their "Do you trust this folder?" prompt, so the project's agent hooks and settings run right away. Without this, each agent asks the first time it runs in a folder. Agents running without you watching, such as orchestration workers, automations and agents started from your phone, will wait at that question until you answer it in their terminal. Folders already trusted stay trusted.

nativeChat.shellEnvNamesLabel: Variables to pass from your shell
nativeChat.resumeCopy: When Orca quits or installs an update, chats that were mid-turn are offered again on the next launch. On, they are reconnected without asking and Orca tells you afterwards — the same thing as ticking "Don't ask again" in that prompt. Off, you choose from the list each time. Reconnecting restores a chat where it stopped; it does not continue the interrupted reply.
nativeChat.shellEnvCopy: Codex and Claude chats start with every variable your login shell exports, the same as a terminal. Turn off to choose which ones they get.
nativeChat.structuredScope: Local macOS and Linux sessions only for now. Windows, WSL, and remote execution hosts (including SSH) continue to use terminal chat.

nativeChat.copy: Enables the experimental Chat UI for newly created supported local sessions. Existing terminal sessions keep the terminal chat path while we tune transcript fidelity, streaming, and parity.
